DESIGN EXPLORATION AUTHORIZED BY MYK, 2026-09-05. Investigate autonomously, compare implementation shapes and produce a reviewable P1 design. No runtime implementation in this ticket; no merge, byte deletion or frozen-rail revision is authorized. PR557/T279 remain separate.

USER STORY AND DECIDED SEMANTICS. Myk creates media_log with movie/book data and registrations, imports it into alice_outbox, and expects that law to apply to ALL deltas within the relevant receiving scope regardless of provenance. Container-local curse withdraws law authority without deleting its deltas; refresh cannot silently lift it. Live bindings follow schema revisions automatically; one-time imports retain their exact imported law/dependency selection while evaluating current relevant destination data. Source retractions and lawful retractions of retractions flow as ordinary deltas over live connections and determine effective source law; no separate withdrawal approval. Bindings/modes/policies are deltas and the same accessible claim closure must reconstruct the same effective state without process memory.

CURRENT RECOMMENDATION. A recipient-authorized standing live relationship supplies authority; source law and local policy project directly. No per-revision receiver signature, adoption-publication record or custom publication DAG. Exact persistent selections are needed for one-time imports and pauses. Live dependencies resolve source-relative names while using the common receiving data scope. Source identity is not a locator, alias or shared signer. All constitutional inputs, not only schema registrations, must be isolated before same-operator source bytes enter administrative readers. MCP governed writes retain standing/author checks; replication retains its distinct verified-union admission. Custody receipts report recovery and do not authorize law. Missing actual dependency references refuse deterministically; version labels do not invent an atomic cross-schema release.

DELIVERABLES. .adlc/specs/60-container-receiving.md contains user stories, evidence census, alternatives, minimal claim/projection contract, 17 proposed verification criteria, concrete replay scenarios, four implementation contracts, exact base-rail impact and migration slices. .adlc/specs/60-container-receiving-review.md records independent findings, corrections, measurements and limits. The earlier per-revision publication proposal is explicitly superseded in the review history. Section 60 is reserved; spec/ remains shipped history.

BASELINE AND DEPENDENCIES. design/container-receive-policy from origin/main 62ee3e9. T263/T278/T279 incomplete. Coordinate minimal explicit-context/constitutional isolation with T274 and local share/offer stories with T264/T265; do not create a T263/T274 cycle. The first proposed implementation proof is a pure receiving-policy projection using real signed fixtures, with no production wiring. Source migration follows explicit input isolation. Onward export is not prerequisite to that proof.

RAIL IMPACT. T200 test/federation/identical-law-two-peers.test.ts has a direct conflict: same friends destination but separate values 11/22; decided common scope plus its timestamp policy implies both 22. Preserve alias binding, real reads, honest reports and outside-scope decoys. T186 private-primary/scoped-door, distinct-incumbent parking, pause and curse rails remain; T33 frozen adoptLaw source-withdrawal behavior remains correct for one-time mode. No rail has been changed. Exact revision authorization must land separately on base before implementation edits a frozen file. New proposed test paths remain rails: [] until authored and measured.

OPEN PRODUCT DECISIONS. Explicit onward export without promotion, and curse handling across genuinely new aliases/recreated relationships. Do not ask again whether law applies across source provenance or whether live source retractions affect downstream state: those are settled. Final P1 approval and P2 DAG/cold-start gates remain pending.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Account for source/ingress/law/curse/export boundaries with exact source and test evidence. Verify: census and rail table in .adlc/specs/60-container-receiving.md.
2. Compare at least three shapes and independently review the minimal recommendation. Verify: alternatives in the working spec and .adlc/specs/60-container-receiving-review.md.
3. Every proposed behavior names a concrete two-sided verification; distinguish proposed tests from measured baseline. Verify: adlc spec-lint .adlc/specs/60-container-receiving.md --json.
4. Record decided semantics, open decisions, corrections and coverage-preserving rail impact without changing runtime/rails. Verify: decision ledger, review history and git diff -- src test scripts spec.
5. Produce concrete bounded implementation contracts and dependency ordering without claiming P2 completion. Verify: implementation contracts and migration sections in the working spec.

MEASUREMENTS. Existing federation/bound-fold/MCP/subtree baseline: 41 files, 268 tests passed. Snapshot/pinning baseline: 4 files, 26 tests passed. Commands and local logs are in the review record. Measurements establish existing behavior, not implementation of the proposed design.
title: SPEC 60 — Unify container receiving and local law adoption
